Package com.atomictempest.holograms.api

package com.atomictempest.holograms.api
  • Class
    Description
    ClickHints
    Tells each player who starts seeing a click box what pressing Use does, in the game's own tick, right after the game itself has told them the box can be used (without a hint, so its client would show no prompt): the hint comes last in the same packet.
    ClickSpot
    An invisible box a player can use: a hologram with a click action stands in one.
    Colours
    Colour codes in hologram text.
    Colours.Run
    A piece of a line in one colour ("#RRGGBB").
    FloatingItem
    An item hanging in the air, for show: nobody can pick it up, it does not fall or merge, and it stays where it is put until moved or removed.
    Hologram
    Floating text: one or more lines stacked upwards from its position (the last line is at the position).
    Holograms
    Floating text and floating items, for any plugin.
    Holograms.Settings
    The admin's settings, read every time they are needed.
    Holograms.Stats
    How Holograms is doing, for /holo stats: pieces by kind (from every plugin), entities in the world now, pictures put in the game's asset list at the start, sendings to players since the start (each a texture reload in their game) and their bytes, pictures waiting to be drawn, drawings done and how long one takes.
    MenuImages
    A picture for a menu: each frame drawn on a square panel (a chequered background where it is see-through) and sent to one player's game as its own image, so an AssetImage shows it sharp, and an animation plays by giving the element the next frame's path.
    Picture
    A picture for a hologram: a PNG, JPG, BMP or GIF (animated GIFs keep their frames and timing), read with limits so a file can never take the server's memory or time: at most Picture.MAX_FILE_BYTES, Picture.MAX_SIDE pixels a side, Picture.MAX_PIXELS pixels and Picture.MAX_FRAMES frames.
    Picture.Problem
    Why a file could not be read.
    Picture.Unreadable
    A file that is not a picture this reads.
    Rankings
    Top lists that leaderboard holograms (/holo create <name> top:<id>) can show.
    Rankings.Entry
    One place: the player's name and their number as players read it ("1,250 copper", "3 jackpots").
    Rankings.Ranking
    A top list.
    Skins
    How players look, kept so a Statue can show a player who is offline.
    Statue
    A life-size figure of a player, in the look they had when last seen (see Skins), turning to face the nearest player.
    StrayPieces
    Takes away pieces that come back by themselves.
    TextImage
    Coloured floating text: the lines drawn into a picture (Colours codes, any colour, gradients) and hung in the world on one flat model that reads the right way from both sides.
    TextImage.Align
    Where coloured lines sit across their picture.
    TextImage.Backing
    What goes behind the text.
    TextImage.PictureFrame
    What goes round a picture: nothing, a light border, a dark panel, or round corners.
    TextImage.PictureMotion
    How a picture moves on its own: still, floating gently up and down, turning round, or both.
    TextImage.TextEffect
    An effect for coloured text: letters typing in, a shine sweeping across, or rainbow colours.
    TextImage.TextFont
    The font coloured text is drawn in: the default rounded sans, a decorative fantasy capital, medieval, a bold serif, comic, cursive, pixel, or monospaced.
    TextImage.TextStyle
    How coloured text looks beyond its codes: the colour of letters without a code of their own (-1: white), the colour and strength (0 to 255) of what goes behind them (-1: the backing's own black and strength), and where the lines sit.
    Turning
    Turns coloured holograms and pictures to face each player who sees them, the way the game sends any entity change: in the game's own tick, right after it has worked out who sees what, each player's turn is queued in that player's own entity updates.
